column1: # flow_ref 1 source=tests/spec/flow_semantics/prev_delay.onsa tests=10 evaluated=10 unavailable=0 skipped=0 waiting=0
@ prev~ outputs the previous sample and starts from +0.0
@ an omitted init is +0.0 in its bits
@ prev~ with an init from the init clock
render prev_delay.one_cfg sr=0x41000000 cfg start=0x40e00000 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000 0x40800000]
@ prev~ with an init expression of the init clock
render prev_delay.one_cfg_expr sr=0x41000000 cfg start=0x40800000 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000]
@ only an explicit -0.0 init starts at -0.0
@ the default of an integer signal is 0
@ delay~ with init fills the first N outputs and keeps wrapping
@ delay~ with an init from the init clock
render prev_delay.two_cfg sr=0x41000000 cfg start=0x40800000 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000]
